title: Partial schema inference for Python Lakeflow pipelines
body:
In an upcoming release, Python Lakeflow pipelines will support partial schema inference in Beta. You will be able to use the `override_schema` argument of `table`, `materialized_view`, or `create_streaming_table` to declare only the columns whose type, constraint, or comment you want to control. The pipeline infers the remaining columns from the query output.

See [Develop pipeline code with Python](/aws/en/ldp/developer/python-dev).
